summary.name: MAC-LIMPO
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar disk cleaner for developer caches (Xcode, Docker, simulators, node_modules) with a disk space analyzer.
keywords: see what takes up disk space mac
use_cases: free up disk space on a developer Mac
clean Xcode and iOS simulator caches
see which folders and file types use the most disk space
find the largest files on a Mac disk
clean package manager caches like Cargo, Go, pnpm and Bun
summary.what_it_does: MAC-LIMPO is a native SwiftUI and AppKit menu bar app for macOS that cleans caches across 46 categories, including Xcode, simulators, Docker, node_modules, Rust target folders, Cargo, Go, pnpm, Bun, Android SDK, .NET, IDE caches, browsers, logs and temp files. The menu bar popover shows disk usage and how much each category would free, and you can clean a single category or all of them. Its Disk X-Ray scans files and maps disk usage by folder tree, file type, and largest files, with a treemap in 2D or a 3D Metal view that you can zoom down to single files. It scans before cleaning, asks for confirmation, moves items to the Trash where possible, and says it only touches caches, not documents. The page describes a build-from-source install via a script that needs macOS 26.6+ and Command Line Tools.
notable: Developer-focused cache categories such as Xcode, Docker, simulators and node_modules
2D and 3D (Metal) disk usage treemap with pinch-to-zoom
Apple Intelligence recommendations, App Intents for Shortcuts and Siri, Liquid Glass UI
No telemetry or account required; GPL-3.0-or-later
caveats: Requires macOS 26.6+ and the Command Line Tools
Installation is by building locally with a script rather than a prebuilt download shown on the page
